{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Galaxy Wanderer''''' was a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury spaceliner]]. During its final voyage, it was hijacked by the [[Malorm family]] while it was passing through [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] space. The Malorms raided the vaults of the ''Galaxy Wanderer'' and spaced more than 30 of its passengers while holding off the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]]. The Malorms evaded capture and the remaining passengers evacuated the ''Galaxy Wanderer'' in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] before it was destroyed.
